name: file-menager
description: Prosty menedżer plików: React SPA + mikroserwisy Express + WebSocket

scripts.services: concurrently -n files,activity,gateway -c blue,magenta,green "node services/files-service/index.js" "node services/activity-service/index.js" "node services/gateway/index.js"
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run services
